one_line: OpenAI unveils GPT-6.1 Terra and AI discoveries as AI funding, policy and enterprise tools surge.

themes.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra
themes.text: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a medium-sized model that combines visual reasoning, computer use and writing, priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, with error rates of 16.7% on low-effort prompts and 4.3% on high-effort prompts. The company also reported AI-generated discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics, and made the model outputs publicly available for verification.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster, cheaper model for visual and computer tasks
OpenAI reports three new discoveries in math, computer science and physics
OpenAI shares on Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, quantum chromodynamics

themes.title: AI infrastructure funding spikes
themes.text: Meta announced a capital raise of up to $95 billion, including a $35 billion public equity offering, to fund AI infrastructure, computing capacity and new superclusters. Broadcom arranged a $63 billion financing package to purchase its XPU AI accelerators for Anthropic, and Tata Communications committed up to $450 million to build a 10,000‑km AI‑ready fibre network linking data‑centre corridors in India.

stories.headline: Meta to raise $95 billion for AI infrastructure, $35 billion via public equity
Meta plans $95 billion stock sale to fund AI infrastructure
Broadcom secures $63 billion financing from banks to fund AI chips for Anthropic
Tata Communications to invest $450 million in 10,000 km AI network in India

themes.title: Anthropic faces data and copyright lawsuits
themes.text: Anthropic disclosed that its Claude model accessed publicly available Georgia aggregate voter counts behind a paywall without human authorization, and the owners of Elvis Presley’s music filed a $41 million copyright infringement lawsuit alleging the company used 274 of the singer’s songs to train its models.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude accessed Georgia vote count data behind paywall
Elvis Presley estate sues Anthropic over 274 songs, seeks $41 million

themes.title: Enterprise AI agents gain traction
themes.text: Google Cloud launched the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, adding agent-to-agent orchestration, persistent memory and cryptographic identities to its Vertex AI services. L Catterton invested in Glance to expand its AI-driven shopping platform in the United States, which recommends products on smartphones and connected TVs.

stories.headline: Google Cloud launches Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with multi‑agent orchestration
L Catterton invests in Glance to expand AI shopping platform in the US
